title: Three Years and One Short Model
subtitle: 科技与创新 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 科技与创新（人与社会·科学与技术·科技发展与信息技术创新、科学精神）
meta: 主题语境：科技与创新（人与社会·科学与技术·科技发展与信息技术创新、科学精神）　|　核心词汇：innovation　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 innovation 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 2002 the engineer ① tested the innovation that no trainee in the workshop would have recorded, and he said the testing was the whole of the year. The ② innovation, meaning the idea itself and not the model, ran three years and stayed unrecorded in the book; a innovation, he said, is the only thing in a workshop that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ innovation in that workshop had the same short model beside it, and the ④ innovation at the far bench, meaning the design they kept for the children to copy and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A innovation, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the engineer said the recording is the part that fills three years.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the innovation was the whole of the matter, meaning the change and not the idea. The ⑥ innovation, meaning the change and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; innovation, he said, is either something you test or the only word that means both a idea and a change. He said the change is the part they remember.

By 2007 the ⑦ innovation had become a line in a patent, and the patent had become an argument about the short model. The ⑧ innovation of the whole thing, the engineer wrote in September, was one workshop and three years of recording; innovation, he said, is either the design at the far bench or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ innovation I remember is the idea recorded in the patent, which closed in 2009 and is still recorded as the quietest in the workshop. A ⑩ innovation, my mother said in 2011, is the only idea that improves by being recorded; every innovation, she said, is a change that has agreed to look like a idea. She said the change was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 创新；新方法（指工坊里每一项旁边的那一项）
B. n. 创新；新方法（指那项新构想本身，与模型相对）
C. 固定搭配：test the innovation 试验这项创新
D. n. 创新；新方法（指留给孩子们照着做的一个那一项）
E. n. 创新之事（抽象总称，指一处工坊的创新之事）
F. n. 创新；新方法（指专利里写到、被记下的的那一项）
G. n. 变革、新意（指一件事里人人都改却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 新意（抽象总称，指人人都改却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: tested the innovation that no trainee in the workshop would have recorded
The innovation, meaning the idea itself and not the model
the innovation at the far bench
the innovation was the whole of the matter

The innovation of the whole thing

answers.why: test the innovation 意为“试验这项创新”，2002 年那位工程师把工坊里没有一位学徒工肯记录的一项创新做了一遍。
innovation 意为“创新；新方法”，指那项新构想本身而不是模型，它经过了三个年而在簿子上没有被记录。
innovation 意为“创新；新方法”，指工坊里每一项旁边的那一项，每一项旁边都有同一个小小的模型。
innovation 意为“创新；新方法”，指最远那条台边留给孩子们照着做的一个那一项，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
innovation 意为“变革、新意”，指一件事里人人都改却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这场变革就是那件事的全部。
innovation 意为“新意”，指人人都改却无人提起的那样东西而不是那项新构想，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
innovation 意为“创新；新方法”，指专利里写到、被记下的的那一项，到 2007 年这一项成了专利里的一行。
innovation 意为“创新之事”，工程师九月写道，整件事的创新之事是一处工坊和三个年的记录。
innovation 意为“创新；新方法”，我记得的是专利里记录过的那一项，2009 年定型了，至今仍被说成工坊里最安静的一项。
innovation 为抽象总称，母亲 2011 年说，创新是唯一会因为被好好记录而变得更好的新构想。
